title: The Brake Light
hook: The getaway car was braking without a driver.

story_audit.goal: Retrieve a cassette containing Lucia's recorded confession from an impounded coupe.
story_audit.stakes: The recording incriminates Lucia; the retrieval is being filmed to identify its owner.
story_audit.obstacle: Jason wants the valuable engine while a cable trap guards the driver door.
story_audit.planted_clue: Brake lights activate while the car is empty; cable runs pedal to office.
story_audit.payoff: Controlling cable exposes camera; passenger-window access recovers tape. Camera setup clip identifies the original Fixer as installer.
story_audit.causal_check: Empty-car braking signals remote mechanical link; following cable reveals staging; chair pull exposes camera; holding tension keeps trip loop stable; recovered footage can identify trap builder, not establish miraculous legal immunity. Camera was left recording during installation; only its first clip reveals installer, not a magical confession from an unknown device.

canon_status: Jason Duval and Lucia Caminos are GTA VI characters in fan-art adaptation. The Fixer is an original supporting character. All plots, jobs, props, businesses and scene-specific sets here are invented noncanon fan fiction.
script: Our getaway car braked without a driver. That was when Lucia stopped calling my plan stupid. Twenty minutes earlier, we'd entered impound to steal the coupe holding her recorded confession under its dashboard. She wanted the tape. I wanted the engine. We argued until its brake lights blinked again. Nobody inside. No keys. But a thin cable ran from the pedal into the inspection office. The recorder wasn't evidence storage. It was bait, wired to trap whoever opened the driver's door. I pulled the cable through the fence instead. The office chair rolled forward, dragging its hidden camera. Back at the blinking lights, Lucia lifted the tape through the passenger window while I held tension. We left the engine. We took the camera too. Its first clip showed the Fixer installing it.
